about: Container images for corpus/run-shard.mjs, pinned by the digest of the multi-platform index (linux/amd64 for the CI lane, linux/arm64 for the Mac lane). runtime: every target's install, set-up, CLI and server run in it. uv: only its /uv binary is copied (read-only) into PyPI targets' containers. Recorded 16 Nov 2026; change only by a reviewed commit. runtimes: other runtime images by name; a target that sets runtime to one of these names runs its sandboxes (install, set-up, CLI, server) in that image instead of runtime. node24 added 18 Nov 2026 for targets whose package requires Node 24.
